root_idea.summary: The root centers on a thing escaping, being lost, passing away, or perishing.
root_idea.development: The basic intransitive idea of loss develops into causative waste and neglect, while related nouns describe abandoned dependents, livelihoods and property, places of ruin, and states of disorder. Some usages extend to the diffusion of scent.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form أَضَاعَ.

senses.definition: To cause something to be lost, perish, or be wasted; to let it go to waste.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive Form IV. In the Quran this is used of works and recompense that God does not allow to perish or be wasted.

senses.definition: To neglect, omit, or leave unattended; to allow a duty or observance to be lost.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive. In أَضَاعُوا الصَّلَاةَ it denotes neglecting or omitting prayer, with reported nuances of delaying it or performing it outside its proper time. In وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ, the cited interpretation understands إِيمَانَكُمْ as the prayer whose merit is not lost.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perish, come to nothing, pass away, or become lost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form I, ordinarily said of a thing that is lost or perishes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be left alone, untended, or neglected.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive; the usage is illustrated of camels and a household left without care.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of perfume or sweet odor, to diffuse its fragrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A usage with the aorist يَضُوعُ, treated as equivalent to the corresponding fragrance usage under ضوع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause something to perish or become lost; to destroy, waste, lose, or squander it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive Form II; it may be used of property and wealth, including squandering and extravagant expenditure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break or fail to keep a compact, contract, or covenant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a covenant or other binding agreement as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In vulgar usage, to behead someone with a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specifically reported colloquial usage, not the ordinary Classical sense of the verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find that one's affair is coming to nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form IV usage distinct from the Quranic transitive uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of one's estates, to become widespread and numerous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive usage referring to property or estates becoming extensive or dispersed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the wind, to blow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is explained in connection with the wind's destroying what it blows upon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of musk, to diffuse its odor or fragrance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a dialectal variant or substitution for تَضَوَّعَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single instance or occasion of perishing, passing away, becoming lost, or being left neglected.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in the expression تَرَكْتُهُ بِضَيْعَةٍ, 'I left him unsought-after, unminded, or unmissed.'

other_classical_meanings.definition: An estate or revenue-producing property, especially land, houses, palm trees, or grapevines.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This sense is associated especially with towns, villages, and cultivated lands; the desert Arabs are reported not to use the word in this sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A craft, occupation, habitual work, trade, or other means of earning a livelihood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes such activities as farming, tending livestock or palms, handicrafts, and traffic or commerce.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Property or affairs in a state of being spread out and disordered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression فَشَتْ ضَيْعَتُهُ, property may become too widespread to gather; the expression can also describe disordered affairs or taking up an irrelevant affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert or waterless place cut off from inhabited regions, where a person may perish or become lost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported nominal extension meaning a place that causes or exposes one to perdition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Death while unsought-after, unminded, or unmissed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction مَاتَ ضَيَاعًا and its reported variants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dependent family or household left untended or liable to perish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage particularly includes dependents unable to manage their own affairs, such as young children or incapacitated persons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of perfume or odoriferous substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal lexical usage distinct from the verbal sense of losing or perishing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Perishing, passing away, becoming lost, or being left and neglected.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active participle of ضاع, used adjectivally or substantivally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who is poor, unable to subsist, or burdened with a household to sustain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported specialized description of a person's difficult circumstances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hungry or empty, especially of the gut.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used idiomatically in فُلَانٌ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى ضَائِعٍ, 'he eats into an empty or hungry gut.'

other_classical_meanings.definition: More perishing, more lost, or in a more ruinous state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Comparative usage, as in comparing one person's condition with another's.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who causes something to be lost or wasted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active participle of the transitive Form IV verb أَضَاعَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One whose estates are becoming widespread and numerous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active participle of the reported intransitive Form IV usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state or place of perishing, abandonment, or ruin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In دَارُ مَضِيعَةٍ it may convey an abode of perdition, abandonment, ignominy, or indolence in one's affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert or other place that causes a person to perish or become lost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported place-noun usage, also found with the variant مَضْيَعَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who wastes or squanders wealth or property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive nominal description, used with لِلْمَالِ, 'with respect to wealth.'

cautions: The Quranic form is normalized under the perfect Form IV citation form أَضَاعَ, although most supplied Quran occurrences are imperfect forms.
In the explanation of وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ, the cited interpretation understands إِيمَانَكُمْ as prayer in its contextual setting.

The estate/property sense of ضَيْعَةٌ is reported with a qualification about its being a later or innovative usage; it is therefore kept as broader Classical coverage rather than as the root's core principle.
